title: Mean of the dual Boolean function
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$. Define its dual by negating the output of $f$ after negating every input coordinate. The mean of this dual function is the negative of the mean of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
